title: Advanced Studies of the Qi-Driven Spread
summary: Teaches a Champion to fill the whole spread with qi so it breaks shield lines and armoured plugs.

title: Canon of the Shattering Pattern
summary: Teaches an experienced shooter to shape a pattern that shatters timber and cover and throws splinters on the foe.

title: Guide to the Breaching Shot
summary: Teaches a Champion to burst hinges and bars and thin walls with a single qi-heavy shot.

title: Treatise on Rolling Fire in Narrow Ways
summary: Teaches a seasoned shooter to fill lanes and alleys with rolling spreads while falling back step by step.

title: The Paired Barrel Treatise
summary: A treatise of the twin barrelled piece that teaches matched loading and two linked shots with shared qi.

title: Hawk and Basin Scattergun Canon
summary: A canon that teaches hawk-like stooping shots from high ground and basin-gathered spreads that open only at the foe.

title: The Twin Reach Fowling Course
summary: A course of river-bank fowling that teaches how to mark and take two foes in turn from reed cover.
